comment: Absolute-path roots in nano/'s shared runtime files (docs/linux/IMPLEMENTATION.md B.5). tools/nano-tree/nanotree/pathroots.py
finds them; tools/nano-tree/tests/test_path_roots.py fails on a root without a row and on a stale row.
root: /<top> or /<top>/<name> ('/<top>/*' covers every root under the top). disposition: link (the Linux root
links it: linux is where it lands, checked against linux/board/common/post-build.d/10-android-links.sh), same (the
Linux system has the path itself), gate (programs the shell gate translates or refuses), kernel (/proc, /sys, /dev),
dropped (its users are [firmware] code), not-reached (nothing on Linux makes it; Nano's use fails softly or is not
reached), not-a-path (the literal is a suffix Nano appends to a folder).

rows.note: configfs's /config/usb_gadget (MTP, NanoMenuMtp.cpp): the Linux image mounts no configfs, MTP is not in the alpha. Also a suffix (RetroArch's <dir>/config).
All of /data is one link into the data partition; S00base makes the tree on first boot. Also a suffix (Flycast's <home>/data).
drastic-nano's APK library warm-up in main.cpp; main_linux.cpp does not run it.
Apps' private folders: on Linux the emulators' homes (S00base makes data/).
The OTA package folder exists (S00base); the OTA hand-off itself is refused (control-keys.json).
local/tmp, 1777 (S00base).
media/0 -> /storage/emulated/0 (S00base).
misc/ (S00base); misc/bootanim and misc/syncthing are not made, and Nano's writes there fail softly.
Nano's state files under their Android names (the plan's 'same file names').
user/0 -> ../data (S00base), as Android's /data/user/0 is /data/data.
Never created on the Linux root (no /dev/block/by-name), and thimsy-session binds /dev/null over the eMMC nodes in Nano's namespace (B.5): NanoScreenCal's baseparameter write finds no node.
Device nodes (dri, input, snd, null, kmsg, urandom, dma_heap): devtmpfs and mdev.
A suffix: <apk>/lib/arm64 in main.cpp's drastic warm-up.
nano-seedrng (its own Android binary); the Linux image keeps its RNG seed in its init scripts.
A directory of the Linux root (the file explorer compares parents with it).
thimsy-session makes <id> -> /storage/<id> there for each mounted drive (the root is read-only).
A legacy Android alias NanoRaConfig recognises in paths read from RetroArch configs; nothing on Linux writes it.
Network shares (gammaos-sharefs, [firmware]); not made on Linux. Nano's checks of it find nothing.
Android's per-user view of emulated storage (Syncthing path mapping); Linux has /storage only.
procfs: self, meminfo, stat, asound, device-tree, net, sys; /proc/bluetooth is Android-kernel only and fails softly.
Android's primary storage alias.
The data partition's mount point.
Drives: thimsy-session mounts each at /storage/<id> (linux/docs/session.md).
emulated/0 on the data partition (S00base).
self/primary -> /storage/emulated/0 (S00base).
sysfs: class (backlight, power_supply), devices, power, module, dev.
A suffix (<dir>/system: DraStic's and Flycast's BIOS folders). The root's /system holds only the links below.
The curated wrappers (empty in the alpha). Programs named here pass through the shell gate first, which translates /system/bin/<posix tool> and refuses Android tools.
thimsy-data's allowed assets.
thimsy-fonts, under the Android names NanoMenuRender.cpp's fontPaths expects.
A suffix: DrasticRunner's <cache>/system/shaders.
The shell gate refuses /vendor programs (setclock_*.sh); /vendor is not made. CPU clocks go through the family hook.
